[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Shusugaunt (species)|Shusugaunt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] carried out a '''jihad''' that took them into [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The superiority of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military forces]] resulted in the jihad ending disastrously for the Shusugaunt.<ref name="Gamer7" />
